CONFIRMED_SOURCE_GAP=cycle/age/geometry validity is not equivalent to security authorization: SnapshotCache can bridge retained pixels, FoldOverlayService has no keyguard/device-lock invalidation, explicit secure capture is collapsed to failure/null, and bridging failure paths can retain stale pixels. GEN2_DIRECTION=service-stable monotonic securityEpoch + exact capture/frame epoch + fail-closed secureCaptureQuarantine; lock/keyguard state changes and secure-capture denial revoke old pixels; only a fresh successful current-context capture can clear quarantine under a new epoch.
